secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key from resend.com — create a free account, add your domain, and copy the API key from Dashboard → API Keys

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key — find it in Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → service_role secret key

secrets.name: DISABILITY_UNIT_EMAIL
secrets.description: The email address of the university Disability Unit that should receive referral notifications

secrets.name: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: The verified sender email address for outgoing referral emails (e.g. SkillQuest <noreply@yourdomain.com>) — must be a domain verified in your Resend account

secrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Slack incoming webhook URL — create one at api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks (choose your channel, e.g. #disability-unit-referrals)
